purpose: Wave-4 Tirannwn/Prifddinas + Anachronia regional skilling depth still missing as first-class rows. Covers Hefin serenity posts, remaining Prif district hubs (Crwys/Cadarn/Trahaearn/Ithell/Iorwerth/Meilyr harmony pillars), Prif spirit-tree Glouron network gate (all_required tirannwn+kandarin), harmonic-dust economy + crystal singing, waterfall fishing depth, crystal teleport seed network + attuned seed equipment, Anachronia overgrown idols, dinosaur farm beans market + animal buyers, Hunter Mark Shop / quick traps / BGH permanent unlocks + poison-frog system, essential oils, Orthen site mastery, and codex lectern. policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography (tirannwn for Prif content under Equilibrium taxonomy; anachronia for island content). region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate (Prif spirit tree needs Tirannwn + Kandarin gnome quest/network). Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.

policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent district infrastructure, travel seeds, dust/tool economy, BGH permanent shop unlocks, farm bean economy, and codex/lectern combat-skilling QoL. Do not mirror every clan shop item or every BGH bait consumable.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour into training truth. Record unlock state, effects, costs, and level gates. Wiki hourly bands may appear as context only.
policy.rs3_terminology: Use crystal urchin points (not OSRS fishing guild). Harmonic dust (harps) is distinct from harmony dust (urchin grind) and harmony moss (Meilyr pillars).
